semantic_audit.rationale: Qualified uncertainty only. Config planner saw initial observations, no cartservice YAML/live environment or Redis connectivity. Runtime wrong destination does not establish environment-variable origin. Not successful diagnosis.

Configuration planner consumed raw telemetry containing failing Redis address, then acquired cartservice YAML, live pod environment and Services. Two configuration sources show invalid REDIS_ADDR, intended Service/dependency and errors support diagnosis. No connectivity query or claim.

Coordinator supplementary round acquired cartservice YAML and successful Redis connectivity. Invalid REDIS_ADDR and intended reachable address support mismatch; separate DNS failures remain unexplained.
